parameters.content:
W11 Broker reminders (4.6 item 7 + W11 row; 4.11 pre-call brief; 4.12a unmarked rule).
(1) 07:30 SAST daily digest broker_daily_digest to every active broker with >= 1 live meeting today (none -> nothing sent) + the same list by email.
(2) Every minute: T-15 min pre-call brief precall_brief. Input built from Postgres only (precall-brief.md "Inputs"): bands, contact data, lead_theme rows (I-22, written by W07), confirm/intro signals, the broker's 'what_mattered' corpus (the last 5 outcomes.summary voice-note summaries for this broker, saved by W29). The LLM relay writes it; briefCheck() gates it; any failure -> deterministic fallback brief (a brief is never skipped). Health detail never leaves Postgres (only "has a health question for you").
(3) Hourly backstop: slot end + 24 h with no outcomes row -> attended + auto_marked + unconfirmed (ON CONFLICT (booking_id) DO NOTHING so it cannot fight W12, which owns the normal path); lead said "No, not yet" -> console queue instead; two unconfirmed for this broker within 30 days -> Jonathan calls the broker (there are no cycles: CRM-NURTURE-SCHEMA.md D7).
Brokers see first name + initial only. Idempotency: lead_activities keys w11:digest:{broker}:{date}, w11:brief:{booking}:{epoch}, w11:auto:{booking}. Logic automation/lib/w11.mjs; tests automation/tests/W11.test.mjs.
NOTE: the brief that launched this asked for broker reminders at T-24 h / T-1 h; 4.6 specifies 07:30 + T-15 and there is no approved broker template for T-24 h / T-1 h - built to 4.6, logged needs_human.

parameters.query:
SELECT a.id, a.broker_id, a.appointment_date, a.method, a.status, l.first_name, l.last_name,
       b.contact_person, b.whatsapp_number, b.email
  FROM public.appointments a
  JOIN public.leads l ON l.id = a.client_id
  JOIN public.brokers b ON b.id = a.broker_id
 WHERE a.brand_id IS NOT NULL
   AND a.status IN ('booked','confirmed')
   AND b.status = 'active'
   AND a.appointment_date >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Johannesburg') AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Johannesburg')
   AND a.appointment_date <  ((date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Johannesburg') + interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Johannesburg')
 ORDER BY a.broker_id, a.appointment_date;

INSERT INTO public.lead_activities (lead_id, brand_id, broker_id, workflow, actor_type, activity_type, payload, occurred_at, idempotency_key)
SELECT NULL, b.brand_id, b.id, 'W11', 'system', 'broker_digest_sent', jsonb_build_object('count', $2::int), now(), $3
  FROM public.brokers b WHERE b.id = $1::uuid
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

parameters.query:
SELECT a.id, a.client_id, a.broker_id, a.brand_id, a.appointment_date, a.ends_at, a.method, a.status, a.call_number, a.join_url,
       a.reschedule_count, a.confirmed_at, a.intro_played_at,
       l.first_name, l.last_name, l.phone, l.age_band, l.budget_band, l.bond, l.dependants, l.work_cover,
       l.call_number AS lead_call_number, l.alt_number, l.best_time, l.language, l.income_band, l.conv_state,
       -- v4: a Teams guest (W05 booking_guest row; the address is dropped from it when the method changes)
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lead_activities g WHERE g.idempotency_key = 'w05:guest:' || a.id AND g.activity_type = 'booking_guest' AND g.payload ? 'guest_email') AS guest_joining,
       b.contact_person, b.whatsapp_number,
       COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(t.payload ORDER BY t.occurred_at) FROM public.lead_activities t WHERE t.lead_id = l.id AND t.activity_type = 'lead_theme'), '[]'::jsonb) AS themes,
       -- what_mattered corpus = this broker's last 5 voice-note summaries (outcomes.summary, saved by W29; there is no insights table)
       COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(q.summary ORDER BY q.marked_at DESC) FROM (SELECT o.summary, o.marked_at FROM public.outcomes o WHERE o.broker_id = b.id AND NULLIF(btrim(o.summary), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.marked_at DESC LIMIT 5) q), '[]'::jsonb) AS corpus
  FROM public.appointments a
  JOIN public.leads l ON l.id = a.client_id
  JOIN public.brokers b ON b.id = a.broker_id
 WHERE a.brand_id IS NOT NULL
   AND a.status IN ('booked','confirmed')
   AND a.appointment_date > now()
   AND a.appointment_date <= now() + interval '15 minutes'
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lead_activities x
                    WHERE x.idempotency_key = 'w11:brief:' || a.id || ':' || extract(epoch FROM a.appointment_date)::bigint);

INSERT INTO public.lead_activities (lead_id, brand_id, broker_id, workflow, actor_type, activity_type, payload, occurred_at, idempotency_key)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, 'W11', 'system', 'precall_brief_sent', jsonb_build_object('booking_id', $4::text), now(), $5)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

SELECT a.id, a.client_id, a.broker_id, a.brand_id, a.ends_at, a.status,
       (SELECT x.payload->>'answer' FROM public.lead_activities x WHERE x.lead_id = a.client_id AND x.activity_type = 'reach_check' ORDER BY x.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS reach
  FROM public.appointments a
 WHERE a.brand_id IS NOT NULL
   AND a.status IN ('booked','confirmed')
   AND a.ends_at <= now() - interval '24 hours'
   AND a.ends_at > now() - interval '14 days'
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.outcomes o WHERE o.booking_id = a.id);

WITH o AS (
  INSERT INTO public.outcomes (booking_id, lead_id, broker_id, brand_id, outcome, lead_reach_check, marked_via, auto_marked, unconfirmed)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::uuid, 'attended', $5, 'auto', true, true)
  ON CONFLICT (booking_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, booking_id, lead_id, broker_id),
a AS (UPDATE public.appointments SET status = 'attended', updated_at = now() WHERE id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM o) RETURNING id),
l AS (UPDATE public.leads SET stage = 'attended', updated_at = now() WHERE id IN (SELECT lead_id FROM o) RETURNING id),
e AS (INSERT INTO public.escalations (brand_id, kind, severity, ref_table, ref_id, lead_id, broker_id, raised_at, note)
      SELECT $4::uuid, 'outcome_unmarked', 'normal', 'outcomes', o.id::text, o.lead_id, $3::uuid, now(), 'esc_kind=outcome_unmarked; auto-marked attended at 24 h, unconfirmed' FROM o RETURNING id)
SELECT o.id AS outcome_id,
       -- 4.12a per broker within 30 days (D7: there are no cycles); same rule as W12. The CTE row is not visible here, hence + 1.
       (SELECT count(*) FROM public.outcomes x WHERE x.broker_id = o.broker_id AND x.unconfirmed AND x.marked_at > now() - interval '30 days') + 1 AS unconfirmed_30d
  FROM o;

parameters.query:
-- I-38d / CONTRACTS.md: the digest is about today's calls with these leads, so their W34 retention clock restarts.
-- Only when Meta accepted the send (wamid). Same leads as the digest: this broker's live meetings today (SAST).
UPDATE public.leads l SET last_contact_at = now()
  FROM public.appointments a
 WHERE a.client_id = l.id AND a.broker_id = $1::uuid AND a.brand_id IS NOT NULL
   AND a.status IN ('booked','confirmed')
   AND (a.appointment_date AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date = $2::date
   AND $3 <> ''
RETURNING l.id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ (() => { const j = $('Digest template payload').item.json; return [j.broker.id, new Date(Date.now() + 7200000).toISOString().slice(0, 10), ($json.messages && $json.messages[0] && $json.messages[0].id) || '']; })() }}

parameters.query:
-- I-38d / CONTRACTS.md: the T-15 brief precedes the broker's call to this lead; restart the W34 retention clock.
-- Only when Meta accepted the send (wamid).
UPDATE public.leads SET last_contact_at = now()
 WHERE id = $1::uuid AND $2 <> ''
RETURNING id;
